name: SparseConvNet-based Skeletal Feature Sampling
definition: A method to sample time-augmented skeletal features at arbitrary 3D query points by diffusing discrete skeletal features into a continuous 3D volume using sparse convolutions, enabling spatially aware feature retrieval for NeRF input.
summary: SparseConvNet-based Skeletal Feature Sampling diffuses discrete skeletal features into a continuous 3D volume using sparse convolutions, improving efficiency by processing only occupied voxels.
